# Torque converter alignment and bolt hole spacing check

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Align notches on the torque converter with those on the oil pump and insert it until seated, then use a straight edge across the housing to verify that bolt holes are spaced at least 25mm apart. [t35]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Align the notches on the torque converter with those on the oil pump.
2. Insert and rotate the converter into place until seated.

_Procedure reported by [t35]._

## Specifications

- **Bolt hole distance from straight edge**: 25mm or more [t35] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a straight edge across the converter housing to verify proper alignment of the four mounting bolts. [t35]
